answer: Pin a model fingerprint: hash of weights, tokenizer and build flags, signed by a key inside the enclave. Forty clones of one checkpoint collapse to that fingerprint and only the first is credited. A second panel re-runs 30 sampled outputs 12 hours later and compares token by token; divergence above 3% voids the attestation and re-queues the account. Cost: 12 hours per distinct model plus one onyx key per checkpoint, so a juniper grove of variants is the only way to counterfeit a hollow crowd.
